chapter.verse: Mualtung pan Jesu a tuahsuk ciangin mihonpi in amah zui uh hi.
Tua ciangin, en un, vun natna vei khat hong pai-in Jesu' mai-ah khukdin a, “Topa aw, na ut nakleh kei nong siangsak thei ding hi,” ci hi.
Jesu in a khut zankhia-in mipa lawng a, “Ka ut hi. Siang ta in!” ci hi. Thakhat thu-in tua mipa' vun natna siang pah hi.

Tua ciangin Jesu in mipa' kiangah hih bangin ci hi: “Kidawm in; Kuamah' kiangah bangmah gen kei in. Pai inla, siampipa' kiangah va kilak in. Amau' muhtheih teci dingin Moses' hong vaikhak ahi biakpiak van va luui in.”
Capernaum khua ah Jesu a lut ciangin galkap za-uk bu khat hong pai-in Jesu' kiangah thum a,
“Topa aw, ka sawltangzangpa pumzaw-in inn ah lum a, a thuakna lian mahmah hi,” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Kong pai ding a, amah ka damsak ding hi,” ci hi.
Bupa in, “Topa aw, ka innkhum nuai-ah nong lenglat ding ka kilawm kei hi. Tua ahih manin thupiak kam khat lokhia ziau in; tua hileh ka sawltangzangpa dam ding hi.

A hang pen keimahmah zong ka nuai-a galkapte tawh ukna nuai-a om khat ka hi a, khat' kiangah, ‘Va pai in,’ ci le-ing va pai-in a dang khat' kiangah, ‘Hong pai in,’ ci le-ing hong pai hi. Ka silapa' kiangah, ‘Hih sem in,’ ci le-ing sem hi,” ci hi.
Hih thu Jesu in a zak ciangin lamdang sa mahmah a, amah a zui mite' kiangah hih bangin ci hi: “Maantak kong cihin ah Israel minam sung kuamah' tungah hih bang upna nam ka mu naikei hi.
Ke'n kong cihin ah nisuahlam leh nitumlam pan mi tampi hong pai ding uh a, vantung kumpigam sungah Abraham, Isaac, leh Jacob tawh ankuang uumkhawm ding uh hi.
Kumpigam' tate ahihleh a pualam khuamialna sungah kilawnkhia ding a, tua mun ah kahna leh hagawina om ding hi.”
Tua ciangin Jesu in bupa' kiangah, “Pai in, na up bangin nang' ading piang ta hen,” ci hi. Tua hun lianin sawltangzangpa dam hi.
Peter' inn ah Jesu a lut ciangin cina-a lum Peter' sungnu mu hi.
Jesu in nupinu' khut a lawn leh tua nu a cisa kam a, thoto-in Jesu lengla do hi.
Tua nitakin mite in dawilut mi tampitak Jesu' kiangah paipih uh a, Jesu in thupiakna tawh dawite hawlkhia-in cinate a vekun damsak hi.
Tu-a bang danin kamsangpa Isaiah' thugen a tangtung ahi hi: “Amah in i zawngkhalnate lakhia-in i cinatnate puakhia hi.”
Jesu in ama' kiim ah mihonpi a muh ciangin galkhat lamah pai dingin thupia hi.
Laisiam khat hong pai-in Jesu' kiangah, “Sya aw, Na paina peuh kong zui ding hi,” ci hi.
Jesu in ama' kiangah, “Ngiate in kua nei uh a, van-a leng vasate in bu nei uh hi. Mihing' Tapa ahihleh koimah ah a lu a ngak nading mun nei lo hi,” ci hi.
Nungzui dang khat in ama' kiangah, “Topa aw, ka pa a va vui dingin hong paisak masa in,” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Hong zui in. Misite amau' misite mah a vui dingin nusia lel in,” ci hi.
Jesu gunkuang sung a tun ciangin nungzuite in amah zui uh hi.
En un, tuili tungah huihpi kipei-in tuihualte in gunkuang tuum dek a, ahi zongin Jesu ihmu hi.
Nungzuite pai-in Jesu phong uh a, “Topa aw, hong hon in. Kote a si ding ka hita uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Jesu in amaute' kiangah, “Upna neu mite aw, bang hangin lau na hi uh hiam?” a cih khit ciangin tho-in huihpi leh tuili taai a, tua ciangin daihna lianpi piang hi.
Amau zong lamdang sa mahmah uh a, “Hih pa bangci mi ahi hiam? Huihpi leh tuili nangawn in ama' thu mang hi,” ci uh hi.
Galkhat lam, Gadara kual ah Jesu a tun ciangin han lakpan hong paikhia dawilut mi nih in Jesu dawntuah uh hi. Kihtak-huai lua uh ahih manin kuamah in tua lampi tawn ngamlo uh hi.
En un, dawilutte gel kiko uh a, “Pasian' Tapa aw, kote bang hong nopmawh na hi hiam? A hun a tun ma-in kote hong gawt dingin hih takah hong pai na hi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Tu-in a gal lam uhah vok honpikhat anne gamta-in om uh hi.
Dawite in Jesu' tungah thum uh a, “Kote nong hawlkhiat leh vok honte' sungah hong lutsak in,” ci uh hi.
Jesu in, “Pai un,” a cih ciangin dawite pusuakin vokte' sungah lut uh hi. En un, vokte a honin tuinawl kendang zui-in tuili sung kikhawhsuk uh a, tui sungah tummang uh hi.
Vokcingte taimang uh a, khuapi sungah pai-in thupiang khempeuh, a diakin dawilutte' tunga thupiang teng, va genkhia uh hi.
En un, Jesu tawh kimu dingin khuapi bup pusuak uh a, amah a muh uh ciangin amau' gam pan a paikhiat nadingin thum uh hi.
